high_level_description: This image captures a serene and picturesque scene featuring a traditional architectural structure with ornate details. The building has a light beige or cream-colored facade, adorned with intricate patterns along the roofline. The roof is decorated with small, repeating motifs that add to the aesthetic appeal of the structure. A peacock stands prominently on the edge of the roof, adding a touch of nature to the scene. The peacock's presence suggests that this might be a location where wildlife is comfortable, possibly indicating a peaceful and natural environment.
